title: Smooth approximants of the Lipschitz cut-off γ_{a,b}∘f with bounded gradients, converging uniformly
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be L-Lipschitz (L ≥ 0, LipschitzWith L f) and let a < b be real. Put h(x) := γ_{a,b}(f(x)) = min{1, max{0, (b − f(x))/(b − a)}}. Then there exist functions h_k : ℝ^P → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) and a real constant c such that: every h_k is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (h_k)); ‖Dh_k(x)‖ ≤ c for all k and x (operator norm of fderiv ℝ (h_k) x); |h_k(x)| ≤ 2 for all k and x; and h_k → h uniformly on ℝ^P as k → ∞ (TendstoUniformly along atTop).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (a b : ℝ), LipschitzWith L f → a < b → ∃ (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (hs k)) ∧ (∀ k x, ‖fderiv ℝ (hs k) x‖ ≤ c) ∧ (∀ k x, |hs k x| ≤ 2) ∧ TendstoUniformly hs (fun x => min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a)))) atTop
